name: The Phoenix Mills Ltd
title: The Phoenix Mills Ltd - 503100 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Retail rentals up 10% to Rs 2,157 cr against consumption up 21%, with ~36-50% of area up for renewal; no new retail capacity added in FY26, so supply discipline is strong and rent growth is the lagging catalyst.

utilisation.quote: our portfolio occupancy on this 4.8 million sq. ft. increased to 70%

capex.quote: we invested approximately Rs. 1,035 crore in construction and development across retail and office assets

triggers.label: Retail consumption +21% to Rs 16,587 cr
triggers.quote: Retail consumption reached an all -time high of Rs. 16,587 crore, growing 21% year-on-year

triggers.label: Blended rent uplift ~20% on FY26 deals
triggers.quote: on a blended average, we have seen nearly a 20% growth in rentals between new deals and renewals combined

triggers.label: Office occupancy 70% on 4.8 mn sq ft
triggers.quote: our portfolio occupancy on this 4.8 million sq. ft. increased to 70%

triggers.label: Office income to double by Q4 FY27
triggers.quote: our quarterly income from office assets should double from current levels by the time next year Quarter 4 comes around

guidance.quote: we are well positioned for a sustained double -digit growth in retail earnings over the next phase
Phoenix MarketCity, Pune, we will see close to 14-15% rental upside in FY27
PMC Bangalore is going to be close to 20% increase in the rental income
we are expecting to launch it during FY28, in the second half of FY28
the trading occupancy should also move up towards the 95-96% levels by the end of FY27

red_flags.label: Rent growth lags consumption (10% vs 21%)
red_flags.quote: we have seen 21% consumption growth has translated to 10% growth in rentals

red_flags.label: Q4 consumption growth ex-jewellery/electronics 17-18%
red_flags.quote: our Q4 consumption growth would come in at about 17 -18% for the rest of the portfolio

evasions.topic: MG vs revenue share split of rent
evasions.quote: We typically don't provide that breakup, Parikshit
We will come back and make those disclosures, Mohit, the minute we start signing LOIs
